value.message: Choose between 'Start fresh' to create a new upgrade plan or 'Proceed with existing configurations' to use or merge past plans.

When starting your upgrade, you can set up an Upgrade Plan to organize and track all related activities. Choose to create a new plan, or import existing upgrade plans and update sets to carry over your previous configurations. If you import multiple plans, you can merge them into one for a consolidated upgrade path. This ensures your upgrade stays aligned, traceable, and easier to manage.
